_oku: ENTEGRASYON KAYITLARI. Anahtar = kanonik cift slug'i (a-vs-b, alfabetik). durum: 'yerlesik' = saticilardan biri digerini KENDI entegrasyon dizininde listeliyor; 'dolayli' = yerlesik baglanti belgelenmemis ama iki taraf da ortak bir baglayiciya (Zapier/Make gibi) sahip; 'yok' = saticinin kendi belgesi bu baglantidan soz etmiyor ve onerdigi yol baska. Buraya YALNIZCA saticinin kendi sayfasinda GORULEN bilgi girilir; kaynakSatiri o sayfadan alinmis gercek cumledir, kaynakSahibi hangi saticinin sayfasi oldugunu soyler. Tahmin girilmez. Kapi: yalnizca GSC'de OLCULMUS talebi olan cift icin kayit acilir -- kartezyen uretim YOK (bkz. 2026-09-12 olcumu: 116 ilk-15 sayfasi ayda toplam 349 gosterim).

convertkit-vs-kajabi.ozet: Kajabi lists Kit (formerly ConvertKit) in its own integrations directory, so the two connect without a third-party bridge.
convertkit-vs-kajabi.kaynakSatiri: Spend less time on your email marketing and more time on creating.

kajabi-vs-mailchimp.ozet: Kajabi lists Mailchimp in its own integrations directory, so the two connect without a third-party bridge.
kajabi-vs-mailchimp.kaynakSatiri: Use custom data from your app to power timely, relevant marketing campaigns.

activecampaign-vs-typeform.ozet: Typeform lists ActiveCampaign among its own connectors, so form responses can reach ActiveCampaign without a third-party bridge.
activecampaign-vs-typeform.kaynakSatiri: Follow up with automated, personalized emails

kajabi-vs-typeform.ozet: Kajabi's own integrations directory does not list Typeform. Kajabi does list Zapier, which is the documented route between the two.
kajabi-vs-typeform.kaynakSatiri: Moves info between your web apps automatically, so you can focus on your most important work.

getresponse-vs-typeform.ozet: GetResponse's own integrations directory does not list Typeform, although it carries a Forms & Surveys category. GetResponse instead points to general connectors, so a bridge is required.
getresponse-vs-typeform.kaynakSatiri: Connect your favorite apps to GetResponse via Albato.

teachable-vs-woocommerce.ozet: Teachable's own WordPress documentation describes a first-party WordPress plugin and never mentions WooCommerce. Teachable sells through its own checkout, so the two run separate carts rather than one.
teachable-vs-woocommerce.kaynakSatiri: The Teachable WordPress plugin seamlessly adds your product information to your WordPress blog or website without the need to duplicate information and connects directly with Teachable's secure checkout platform.
